title: CWP/15749/2022 of KULWINDER SINGH AND ORS Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND ANOTHER
text:
106+213 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Date of Decision:04.04.2025 KULWINDER SINGH AND OTHERS ......... Petitioners Versus STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS ….... Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JAGMOHAN BANSAL Present : Mr. R.K. Arora, Advocate for the petitioners. Mr. Aman Dhir, DAG, Punjab. JAGMOHAN BANSAL, J. (Oral)

1. The petitioners through instant petition under Articles 226/227 of the Constitution of India are seeking direction to respondents to consider them for promotion.

2. The petitioners claim that they joined Punjab Police as Drivers. They are working on the post of Drivers for more than 10 years. The candidate who joined alongwith them on other posts including ClassIV have been further promoted but there are no in promotional avenues for the Drivers.

3. Mr. Aman Dhir, DAG, Punjab submits that a Committee was constituted to examine claim of the petitioners. A report has been received from the Committee and Competent Authority would, in due course, consider report of the Committee.

4. Mr. R.K. Arora, Advocate for the petitioners submits that respondents may be directed to taken decision on the report of the Committee expeditiously.

5. In the wake of statement of both sides, the present petition stands disposed of with a direction to Home Secretary to examine report of the Committee alongwith law laid down by Supreme Court. Let the needful be done expeditiously and preferably within 06 months from today. ( JAGMOHAN BANSAL ) JUDGE 04.04.2025 Ali
